tasks.short: Demonstrate skin care and recommend a regimen

steps.what: Recommend a skin-care regimen suited to the client's needs
Demonstrate cleaning and care techniques and check client understanding

tasks.design: Keep personalised advice and demonstrations in person. The {CRM} client card can supply existing preferences, with no reduction attributed to its runtime.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effective advice depends on the client and the observed skin condition.
tasks.enabler_now: No new tool is needed for the demonstration.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing when routine advice is unsuitable and referral is needed.
tasks.human_edge: Adjust the demonstration to client understanding and comfort.
tasks.altitude: Advice and demonstration time remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Demonstration and individual regimen advice remain personal work in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is advice and demonstration after assessment; assessment and record keeping are counted in their own tasks.
Client supplies needs verbally; specialist interpretation is counted in s1, with no structured intake assumed.
No new configuration or recurring upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Typical client needs and treatment scope
research_questions: Which demonstrations most often require repetition or adaptation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 net0 with zero upkeep; hands-on demonstration remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select products or colors for the client

steps.what: Determine which products or colors suit the client's skin and preferences

tasks.design: Retain specialist selection based on assessment and discussion. Use existing product information in {DOCS} when needed; no automated skin diagnosis or color choice is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Product suitability depends on observed skin, sensitivities and preferences.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing product information is sufficient to support the decision.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a cosmetic preference from a condition requiring referral.
tasks.human_edge: Combine observation, client feedback and product knowledge.

evidence.claim: The digest does not establish an automated skin-product selection capability; this design retains specialist judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is the selection decision, excluding skin examination and subsequent regimen demonstration.
Client supplies preferences and specialist reads product information during this fully retained step.
Test existing information access before any development; no change and zero upkeep are assumed.
unknowns: Product range and permitted treatment scope
research_questions: Which selection decisions require additional product information?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; product suitability judgement remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture client needs, preferences and services provided in the client record
Check the completed client record for accuracy and necessary detail

tasks.design: Configure the existing {CRM} client card with reusable service fields and a short free-text note. The specialist captures new observations and checks the final record; no inferred health facts are inserted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated service descriptions and scattered notes make records slow to maintain.
tasks.enabler_now: Native client cards support treatment notes and history.
tasks.still_hard: Recording only necessary information and preserving the meaning of client concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what observation matters for safe follow-up.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated typing, with the same responsibility for record accuracy.

evidence.claim: Salonized client management supports treatment history, notes, photos and intake forms.
A 15-hour gross reduction from simpler entry is a scenario, not a measured result.

assumptions: Boundary is record maintenance, excluding examination, treatment and advice.

Specialist produces client id, encounter date, performed service, necessary preferences and new observations during s1. All new capture remains in its 60 retained hours; appointment defaults are checked rather than assumed to be performed services.
Missing or changed information is typed manually; no existing structured health record is assumed.
Test native fields and permissions first. Ordinary product catalogue maintenance remains existing work; additional note-field upkeep is counted below.
research_questions: Does a timed trial reduce repeated typing without losing clinically relevant observations?

already_counted.description: Capture new facts and check defaults

incremental.description: Maintain service fields and correct entry issues

approvals.approved_version: Exact client, encounter and note version checked by the specialist; edits require a fresh check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85 gross15 minus3 upkeep =12 net E1. High assumes repeated service typing today; low covers mostly unique notes or already efficient cards.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Examine clients' skin with magnifying lamps or visors when necessary

tasks.design: Keep skin examination with the specialist using appropriate physical aids. The {CRM} may hold prior notes; its runtime does not replace direct observation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Skin condition must be assessed in the actual treatment context.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising findings outside the specialist's competence.
tasks.human_edge: Observe, ask questions and decide when to stop or refer.
tasks.altitude: Examination time and responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Direct skin examination is retained; no automated diagnosis saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is examination, excluding separately counted recording and product selection.
Specialist produces the assessment through direct observation and discussion in the fully retained step.
No new software or structured capture is required and incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Available examination aids and referral protocol
research_questions: When does an observed condition require referral rather than treatment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; direct examination remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Simpler client notes, with assessment and personal advice unchanged.
reach: Coordinate necessary follow-up information with reception
role.ambitious_version: A specialist who maintains useful records with less repeated typing.
